newsitem.title: USA: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear unit seen at 68 pct to Fri.
newsitem.headline: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear unit seen at 68 pct to Fri.

text.p: The 1,158 megawatt (MW) WNP-2 nuclear power plant at Richland, Wash., will remain at 68 percent capacity through Friday, a spokesman for the plant said Tuesday.
Operations have been curtailed since last Wednesday due to the latest round of problems with a computerized adjustable speed drive installed at the plant last year.
"We are still in the trouble-shooting process. We also plan to make some changes in electrical grounding," spokesman Richard Romanelli said.
Meanwhile, WNP-2 is scheduled to close for a 42-day refueling outage on April 12.
There have been talks on extending the outage, but nothing is final as yet, Romanelli added.
